answer: A relic of per-task receipts records who did what, and the violet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vault of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
